name: Hi-Light 航轮 G7.2
why_interesting: A 45 mm-clearance titanium gravel bike with a selected 8.0 kg GRX810 marketplace build plus several exact mainland alternatives.

facts.drivetrain: Shimano GRX RX810 mechanical 1×11; 40T or 42T chainring and 11–42T cassette
facts.complete_weight_basis: Seller-listed approximate complete-bike weight for selected option 7; size, pedals and measurement method are not stated
facts.frame: Hi-Light G7.2 titanium frame with GFK70 carbon fork
facts.frame_material: Titanium frame with hydroformed shaped, variable-wall tubes; exact titanium grade is not published
facts.frame_construction: Hydroformed shaped and variable-wall tubes, CNC-formed dropouts and replaceable AL-6061-T6 dropout inserts
facts.tire_clearance_basis: Manufacturer maximum: ETRTO 47-622 / 700×45C on the exact G7.2 frame
facts.tires: Maxxis 700×35C folding tires with 32–45C TPU tubes
facts.cockpit: Panshi Ni third-generation carbon integrated cockpit and Asian carbon seatpost
facts.brakes: Shimano GRX hydraulic calipers with CL800 160 mm center-lock rotors
facts.sizes: S, M, L, XL, XXL and XXXL; custom sizing offered

official_price.price_basis: G7.2 GRX GR1600 complete bike with the official RX810 / GR1600 component list

observed_price.price_basis: Selected Taobao option 7: G7.2 lightweight race build with GRX810 1×11 and seller-custom carbon wheels

alternative_builds.label: Official RX810 2×11 / GR1600 build
alternative_builds.drivetrain: Shimano GRX RX810 mechanical 2×11; 48/31T crank and 11–32T cassette
alternative_builds.notes: Manufacturer publishes a complete BOM but leaves the complete-bike weight field blank.

alternative_builds.notes: The panel lists an optional GRX810 upgrade for CNY 1,080 or GRX820 upgrade for CNY 1,560; neither upgrade is included in the selected price.
